torlink.news.title: Search online with Torlink
torlink.news.body: An optional add-on in the GitHub edition for online search and managing downloads.
torlink.news.detail: Torlink is an optional module available only in the GitHub edition of the player. It adds an online search page and a download manager, starts only with your consent and can be turned off in Settings → Torlink. It is not part of the Microsoft Store edition.
